labels: Measured in the review sandbox unless marked; scratch scripts are not committed

stand_in_teacher.model: 3-layer width-128 single-head RoPE attention byte LM (textlm 'attn'), 607,488 parameters
stand_in_teacher.data: WikiText-2 raw bytes; valid bpb on 256 windows of 128 bytes

conversion_kd.method: zero-shot scale fit, then 400 KD steps (32x128 bytes) on Q/K + per-layer temperature, then 400 on all weights

drift_vs_curvature_real_heads.metric: mean row KL(teacher || variant) at log eps = -3 (t = e^-6 * |k|^2)

data_objective_fine_tune.method: 600 next-byte steps from the teacher, Adam lr 3e-4, curvature lr 1e-2

m3_integer_engine.label: Measured on the 4-vCPU x86-64 review container unless stated

exactness_chain.vector_kernels_vs_portable: bit-identical on random and extreme matrices; AVX2 native, NEON under qemu-aarch64 user-mode emulation; portable kernel equal to exact i128 products

small_llama.training: WikiText-2 bytes, 2300 steps x 16 x 256 tokens, AdamW, single core, 1920 s; throwaway JAX script in scratch (not in the repository)
small_llama.reduced_run_note: with 1024 calibration and 512 evaluation positions GPTQ lowered KL (2.2e-3 vs 5.4e-3) and raised top-1 (98.4% vs 96.5%) but its NLL change was larger (+0.0061 vs +0.0039); NLL change is too noisy at that size

throughput_random_135m_shape.note: x86-64 VM, not an M1; the four context-256 runs were paused during each measurement
